name: transcribe-mcp

tools.name: transcribe_url
tools.description: Turn audio or video into text with per-segment timings and a detected language. Give it a public "url", or a local audio "file" — its bytes are sent to the shop, no hosting needed. Costs $0.05 per call, paid in USDC from your own wallet. The file must be under 800 KB; oversized files are refused for free before any payment.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the audio or video file (video is experimental; a file with no speech is still billed). Use this or file, not both. One paid call per wallet at a time — never call in parallel.

file.description: Absolute path to an AUDIO file on this machine (.mp3 .wav .m4a .aac .ogg .opus .oga .flac). Video: extract the audio with ffmpeg first. Use this or url, not both.

save_to.description: Optional absolute path to a NEW .json file (never overwrites; its folder must exist). Writes the full JSON result there and replies with a one-line summary — keeps long transcripts out of your context.

tools.name: find_dead_air
tools.description: Given subtitles or timings, return the spans of dead air and how much of the runtime cutting them would save. Costs $0.002 per call — a tenth of transcription, because the expensive half is not redone. Feed it the segments transcribe_url returns.

vtt.description: WebVTT subtitles. Use this or segments, not both.

from_file.description: Path to a JSON file holding {segments, durationSeconds} or {vtt}. Use instead of passing them inline when there are many.

segments.description: Timings as [{start, end, text}] in seconds — exactly what transcribe_url returns.

durationSeconds.description: Total runtime in seconds. Improves the saving estimate; optional.

save_to.description: Optional absolute path to a NEW .json file (never overwrites; its folder must exist). Writes the full JSON result there and replies with a one-line summary — keeps long transcripts out of your context.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Fetch a web page and get back the words: headings, paragraphs and links, without the navigation, scripts or cookie banners. Set render:true for pages that are blank until JavaScript runs — same price. $0.005 per page, paid in USDC from your own wallet. No account and no API key, which is the point: an agent cannot sign up for one.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to read.

render.description: Run a real browser first, for pages that need JavaScript. Same price.

tools.name: shop_info
tools.description: Free. Returns the prices, the size limit, the chain and how payment works, so an agent can decide whether to call the paid tools at all.
